Subject: Re: Draft offer ready for Lena Ortiz — headcount & clauses

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed and attached an annotated PDF with suggested redlines (offer-redlines-legal-annotated.pdf). High-level:

- Remove the explicit "tax gross-up" language — we should not guarantee gross-ups except in rare executive cases. If candidate presses, we can offer a one-time reimbursement for documented tax advice up to $1,000 but not a gross-up.
- Severance: the current draft reads like an entitlement. Change to "mutual separation compensation" only for director+ roles; for ICs we should keep at-will and offer a discretionary lump sum if we provide a separation package.
- At-will employment: add clear at-will sentence and a paragraph on arbitration if we have an arbitration policy in effect.
- Probation/check-in: 90-day onboarding review is fine as a planning checkpoint, but avoid language that could be read as a probationary employment status that restricts termination rights.

I flagged one exception request (sign-on split by timing) that will need an EVP approval if we want to front-load more than 50% upfront.

Attached: offer-redlines-legal-annotated.pdf (application/pdf)

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Offer from Redwood — Lena Ortiz (please review)

Hi Lena (and Sam),

Great to talk last week. Attached is the formal offer (LenaOrtiz-offer-v2.pdf) for the Senior Inference Engineer position. Key points (consolidated):
- Base salary: $190,000
- Sign-on: $25,000 (50% on signing, 50% at 6 months)
- RSU: 0.6% target, 4-year vest schedule with 1-year cliff
- Start window: we propose Sep 20 — Oct 4; your note that late September works has been accounted for
- Site visit: Redwood will reimburse up to $2,000 for a one-day site visit (travel + hotel) and cover a modest relocation consult if requested
- At-will employment language included; legal updated tax language (no gross-up, one-time tax-advice reimbursement up to $1,000)

Headcount/budget: Vivek has confirmed ENG-2026-HIRE-34 and sign-on is approved at $25k.

Next steps: please review the attached PDF and sign via DocuSign if agreeable: https://app.docusign.com/abcdef-lemniscate-2026. If you prefer, Sam can coordinate scheduling a quick call to walk through.

We aim to have you start between Sep 20 and Oct 4; if you need a different window, let us know and we'll be flexible.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
